name: Cambridge YMCA Summer Program
description_short: A full-day summer program (8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.) for ages 5–13 at the Cambridge YMCA. Children are grouped in age-based classrooms. Days include swimming, gym time, teacher-led activities such as arts and crafts, games and STEM, and weekly field trips.
refund_policy_summary: You pay a $150 non-refundable deposit for each enrolled week once your child is accepted. The page does not give any other refund terms.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming is listed as one of the program's activities. The page does not say whether it is a pool or lessons, or how swimmers are supervised or tested.
